title: Finance: Present Value Annuities, Loans and the Number of Payments
seo_title: Grade 12 Present Value Annuities and Loans Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Solve problems involving present value and future value annuities; make use of logarithms to calculate the value of n, the time period; critically analyse investment and loan options.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 12 finance worksheets: present value annuities, monthly loan repayments and the number of payments. 100 questions with memos.
key_sub: Round the number of payments up.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A loan is a present value annuity: P = x[1 − (1 + i)−n]i.
  • To find the payment, make x the subject: x = P × i1 − (1 + i)−n.
  • To find n, isolate (1 + i)−n and use logs.
  • If n is not a whole number, round up: the last payment is smaller.

Examples

Example

R100 000 at 12% p.a. monthly, 5 years

i = 0,01, n = 60

Answer: x = R2 224,44

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
P ÷ nThat ignores interest.
F or PA loan uses the present value formula.
Rounding downRound the number of payments up.

faq.a: Interest is charged on the balance.
